Attempted Bank Robbery in Chhindwara Foiled; One Suspect Apprehended

In Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh, an attempted robbery at a Bank of India branch was thwarted when perpetrators threw a bomb. The incident caused smoke but did not deter the police, who remained on site. Local citizens managed to apprehend one of the suspects.
